target_customer: Employers, especially startups and ambitious companies, buying health benefits for staff
problem: Employer health insurance is costly and reactive. Prescience claims AI-steered plans can cut employer cost by 20 to 50 percent while keeping benefits rich.
business_model: Health benefits platform and licensed TPA selling employer health plans, with HSA, COBRA, ACA and payroll administration; pricing not stated
product_category: AI health benefits and insurance platform

founders.name: Rishab Jain
education: Harvard College, Computer Science and Neuroscience
previous_startups: An edtech company he founded and exited (name not given on YC page)
founders.background_notes: RSI alumnus and International Science and Engineering Fair winner per YC page

founders.name: Aditya Jain, MD
founders.background_notes: ML research since 2014 and Op-Med Fellow at Doximity per YC page

competitors.name: Curative
competitors.what: Zero copay and deductible health plan on a curated network, with AI features
competitors.traction_then: Over 1,200 employer clients and 165,000 members reported in 2025
competitors.funding_then: $150M Series B at $1.275B valuation announced December 2025

competitors.name: Angle Health
competitors.what: AI-powered level-funded health plans for small and midsize employers
competitors.traction_then: More than 5,000 employer groups in 47 states
competitors.funding_then: $134M Series B reported December 2025; a $600M raise at $2.7B valuation reported September 2026

competitors.name: Sana Benefits
competitors.what: Level-funded all-in-one plan with virtual primary care

technical_complexity.rationale: Plan administration, claims and compliance filings are standard but wide in scope. The claimed AlphaGo-like trajectory model is unverified, and operating as a licensed TPA adds regulatory work.

defensibility.rationale: TPA licensing is a barrier, but funded rivals with thousands of groups already sell AI health plans. The savings claim lacks customer level proof per press.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals raised large rounds around the same time; no direct action against Prescience reported.

market_need_then: Mercer found employer health benefit cost per employee rose 6% in 2025 and projected 6.7% for 2026, and investors were funding AI-native small business health plans in 2025 and 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses getprescience.com, a get prefix domain (company site)

identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious AI framing with named concepts such as Time Machine, Move 37 and Diamond plan tier

branding.brand_signature: Move 37 and Time Machine product names, drawing on AlphaGo imagery (the link to AlphaGo is an inference from the YC description, not stated by a source)

brand_strength.rationale: Launched in July 2026 and covered by one trade outlet (Runtime Wire); name is shared with other firms such as Prescient and Prescience Health, which dilutes search.

outcome_analysis: Prescience launched in July 2026 and is Active, so there is no outcome yet. It faces well funded AI health plan rivals, and its 20 percent savings claim still needs customer level proof, so early customer results and TPA execution will drive whether it raises.
notes: No funding found. A CB Insights record of a 2020 merger for Prescience Health in Tennessee appears to be a different company and is excluded. A second YC listing at ycombinator.com/companies/prescience shows team size 2 and Boston, while the directory data says team size 5 and San Francisco; unresolved. Funding search plus cross-check found no round.
